messages:
alex: Heads-up: tonight 22:00-02:00 UTC quiet window. Coordinated change across API, runtime, console, router. Need owners + rollback in this thread.

deploy-bot: Window scheduled. Runbooks RB-9001 attached. Please ack ownership.

tess: I'll own API. Gate schema change behind feature-flag for canary only.

nate: Runtime owner. Pin image rwinference:2.4.1-canary, start at 3% traffic. Watch KV miss and GPU OOMs.

alex: Router owner?

ops-oncall: I can patch router if needed; but prefer maria to perform header swap.

maria: I'll do router header-split with shadowing first, then 1%->5% ramp. Rollback if mismatch >0.5% or routing 5xx spike.

alex: Rollout plan: runtime canary -> router shadow -> api flag -> console gate. Rollback triggers: p95>2000ms for 5m, 5xx +5ppt, KV miss +20%.

nate: Runtime rollback snippet: ```bash
deploybot rollback --service runtime --to-image rwinference:2.3.9 --immediate
```

tess: API rollback: flip feature flag back and remove canary route.

maria: Router rollback: ```bash
rtrctl set --route header-split --version v0.9.2 --reason "rollback"
```

ops-oncall: Standing up #ephemeral/deploy-1769998888 and enabling pages for thresholds. 15min post-100% watch.

alex: All acked. Start at 22:05 UTC to give teams time to stage. Ping @ops-oncall + @deploy-bot on any rollback. Thanks.
